title: model_compatibility
description: How OpenAI model names are recognised and which model each operation uses by default (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8c). The path of the generated OpenAI model list is not a setting: it is the release file registry/openai_model_aliases.generated.yml.

enabled.description: When false, a requested model name is used as sent: no OpenAI-name recognition and no default model.

openai_models_api_url.description: The model list that `proxy.py refresh-openai-models` reads to regenerate the release list.

include_private.description: When true, the refresh keeps fine-tunes and models owned by other accounts.

defaults.description: The model an operation uses when the request names none or names an OpenAI model. Keyed by operation (chat, completions, speech, transcriptions, embeddings, images, image_edits, videos). An operation with no entry falls back to its engine's default.

aliases.description: Model names the gateway should treat as an OpenAI family, keyed by model id. A value is a family name (for example embeddings) or an object with a category or operation.
